CLINICAL INDICATION: Monitoring of chronic kidney disease

COMPREHENSIVE METABOLIC PANEL:

Test                   Result      Reference Range     Flag
---------------------------------------------------------------
Glucose                145 mg/dL   70-99 mg/dL         HIGH
Creatinine             2.1 mg/dL   0.6-1.1 mg/dL       HIGH
eGFR                   34 mL/min   >= 60 mL/min        LOW
Potassium              5.4 mEq/L   3.5-5.0 mEq/L       HIGH
Hemoglobin A1c         8.2 %       < 5.7 %             HIGH

INTERPRETATION:
Findings consistent with Stage 3b Chronic Kidney Disease (CKD). Elevated glucose and HbA1c indicate poorly controlled Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus. Hyperkalemia present; dietary potassium restriction advised. Follow-up repeat CMP in 3 months recommended.
